headword: {色素|しきそ}{沈着|ちんちゃく}

definitions.explanation: The deposit of pigment in the skin, resulting in darker patches or spots. A common dermatological concern caused by sun exposure, inflammation, aging, or hormonal changes.

examples.japanese: {日焼|ひや}けによる{色素|しきそ}{沈着|ちんちゃく}に{注意|ちゅうい}してください。
examples.english: Please be careful about pigmentation from sunburn.

examples.japanese: ニキビの{跡|あと}が{色素|しきそ}{沈着|ちんちゃく}になってしまった。
examples.english: The acne scars turned into pigmentation marks.

examples.japanese: {色素|しきそ}{沈着|ちんちゃく}を{防|ふせ}ぐには、{紫外線|しがいせん}{対策|たいさく}が{大切|たいせつ}だ。
examples.english: To prevent pigmentation, UV protection is important.

notes:
Compound of {色素|しきそ} (pigment; coloring matter) + {沈着|ちんちゃく} (deposition; settling). A medical and skincare term that is widely understood due to the popularity of skincare culture in Japan.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {色素|しきそ}{沈着|ちんちゃく}を{防|ふせ}ぐ: to prevent pigmentation
- {色素|しきそ}{沈着|ちんちゃく}が{起|お}きる: pigmentation occurs
- {色素|しきそ}{沈着|ちんちゃく}を{改善|かいぜん}する: to improve pigmentation
- {炎症後|えんしょうご}{色素|しきそ}{沈着|ちんちゃく}: post-inflammatory hyperpigmentation

COMMON CAUSES:
- {紫外線|しがいせん}: UV rays
- ニキビやけがの{跡|あと}: acne or injury scars
- {加齢|かれい}: aging
- ホルモン{変化|へんか}: hormonal changes

SIMILAR WORDS:
- シミ: age spots; dark spots — the everyday word for visible pigmentation spots on the skin
- {黒|くろ}ずみ: darkening; dark patches — more casual, used for skin darkening in general
- {日焼|ひや}け{跡|あと}: sunburn marks — specifically from sun exposure
